newsitem.title: USA: Micron Technology says profits fall sharply.
newsitem.headline: Micron Technology says profits fall sharply.

text.p: Micron Technology Inc. said Monday its profits fell about 94 percent in the latest quarter due to significantly lower prices for semiconductor memory products.
The Boise, Idaho-based company said its net income dropped to $20.6 million, or 10 cents a share, in its first fiscal quarter ended Nov. 28, from $328.5 million, or $1.51 per share, a year ago.
Sales fell 39 percent to $728 million from $1.19 billion.

The company said while its semiconductor operations more than doubled production in megabit terms in the first quarter of fiscal 1997 vs. a year ago, the average selling price per megabit fell 84 percent.
